select bm_storage_material.id as storage_material_id, bm_storage_material.no as storage_material_no, bm_free_weigh_history.weigh_time, bm_material.merge_code, bm_material.name as material_name, bm_storage_material_batch.material_batch_no as storage_material_batch_no, bm_free_weigh_history.tare_weight, bm_free_weigh_history.net_weight, bm_free_weigh_history.gross_weight, bm_free_weigh_history.unit_id, bm_free_weigh_history.weigher_id, bm_free_weigh_history.re_checker_id, bm_free_weigh_history.container_name, bm_free_weigh_history.position_name, bm_material_category.category_type from bm_free_weigh_history left join bm_storage_material on bm_free_weigh_history.storage_material_id = bm_storage_material.id and bm_storage_material.is_deleted = 0 left join bm_material on bm_storage_material.material_id = bm_material.id and bm_material.is_deleted = 0 left join bm_material_category on bm_material_category.id = bm_material.material_category_id and bm_material_category.is_deleted = 0 left join bm_storage_material_batch on bm_storage_material.storage_material_batch_id = bm_storage_material_batch.id and bm_storage_material_batch.is_deleted = 0 where bm_free_weigh_history.is_deleted = 0
and bm_storage_material.no like concat('%',#{pageQuery.storageMaterialNo},'%')
and bm_storage_material_batch.material_batch_no like concat('%',#{pageQuery.storageMaterialBatchNo},'%')
and bm_free_weigh_history.weigh_time > concat(#{pageQuery.weighDateStart}, ' 00:00:00')
and bm_free_weigh_history.weigh_time <= concat(#{pageQuery.weighDateEnd}, ' 23:59:59')
order by bm_free_weigh_history.create_time desc
